name: Naturalization by Marriage (Expedited Track)

qualifying_event.description: A foreigner married to an Albanian citizen for at least 3 years may naturalize under relaxed conditions, without needing to meet the standard 7-year residence and language/history requirements.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; spouse's proof of Albanian citizenship; proof of 1 year continuous lawful residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being married to an Albanian citizen for at least 3 years.

Requires at least 1 year of continuous lawful residence in Albania -- distinctly shorter than the standard naturalization route's 7-year bar, and the language/history knowledge requirement does not apply on this track.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 1 year of continuous lawful residence.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 1 year continuous lawful residence

sources.title: Republic of Albania -- Law No. 113/2020 on Citizenship (official English translation): marriage-based expedited naturalization -- 3+ years married to an Albanian citizen plus 1 year continuous lawful residence, exempting the standard 7-year residence and language/history requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). Gender-neutral on its face -- the law text extracted refers to 'a foreigner married to an Albanian citizen' without gendering either spouse, a genuine contrast worth noting against this dataset's other marriage-route files that carry explicit gender restrictions (e.g. UAE, historically Bahamas). This is a real, substantial fast-track: 1 year of residence plus a 3-year marriage clock (which can run concurrently with the residence period) versus the standard route's 7-year residence-plus-language-test bar -- see al_naturalisation.json.
